srs.title: Spaced repetition
srs.description: Only for spaced repetition trainers. Classic trainers have no defaults here: you set their question type and time limit when you create them.
srs.newTrainersDescription: Starting values for spaced repetition trainers you create. Trainers you already have are not changed.
srs.recallSentence: At {percent}%, you will recall about {recall} of every 10 words when they come up for review. A higher target means more reviews.
srs.directionsDescription: Each direction is reviewed on its own. The directions of a trainer cannot be changed after it is created.
srs.emailRemindersDescription: One email per trainer per day, skipped when nothing is due. It stops after 3 emails without a review.
srs.emailReminderLabel: Email me when cards are due
srs.allTrainersDescription: Applies to every spaced repetition trainer as soon as you save.
srs.timezoneHint: Your review day starts at 04:00 in this timezone, so studying after midnight still counts for the day before.
srs.timezoneDetected: Detected from your browser: save to keep it.
srs.saveFootnote: Timezone applies to all trainers. Other settings apply to new trainers.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Personal API keys for automations like the iOS quick-add Shortcut. Each key is scoped to one action and one folder.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create one to connect an iOS Shortcut or other automation.
apiKeys.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? Anything using this key (e.g. an iOS Shortcut) will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.revealDescription: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it somewhere safe — you won’t be able to view it again after closing this dialog.
apiKeys.quickAddHint: Lets this key create new vocab entries in one folder — nothing else.
apiKeys.noFolder: You don’t have a language folder yet — quick-add needs one to know what folder and language pair to file words into.
apiKeys.selectFolderRequired: Select a language folder for quick-add
